analogy.rationale: NAMPT inhibition depletes NAD+, impairing NAD+-dependent enzymes and nucleotide metabolism, so antiproliferative/antimetabolite classes that block DNA synthesis or nucleotide supply should share downstream growth-arrest and stress programs; direct pathway overlap is limited, so similarity is only medium.
